Filtered Relevant Items:
1. [10] ZooKeeper logs “Connection request from old client … will be dropped if server is in r-o mode” when the client handshake omits the optional read-only flag; the discussion proposes lowering this message from WARN to DEBUG.
2. [11] The same warning is described as acceptable for older clients connecting to ZooKeeper 3.4.6; supporting read-only mode requires sending the added read-only flag.
3. [16] A developer confirms that this old-client warning alone should not cause a connection failure.
4. [1] A ZooKeeper leader log shows follower synchronization with “Sending DIFF,” followed by transaction-log creation and successful client session establishment.

External Knowledge Summary:
- The “old client” warning indicates that the client did not send the optional read-only capability flag.
- Such clients are only subject to being dropped when the server operates in read-only mode; the warning alone does not indicate a failed connection.
- “Sending DIFF,” creating a transaction log, and establishing negotiated client sessions also appear in normal ZooKeeper synchronization and startup activity.
